title: South Carolina Code of Laws Title 9, Chapter 1 - South Carolina Retirement System
source_id: S.C. Code Ann. tit. 9, ch. 1 (secs. 9-1-10 to 9-1-2210)
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 9 chapter index (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title9.php): title 'Title 9 - Retirement Systems', chapter row 'CHAPTER 1 - SOUTH CAROLINA RETIREMENT SYSTEM' with no [REPEALED] marker (sibling 'CHAPTER 2 - RETIREMENT AND PRERETIREMENT ADVISORY PANEL [REPEALED]' shows the marker is in use); then fetched https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t09c001.php, whose heading reads 'CHAPTER 1 / South Carolina Retirement System', with Articles 1 (General Provisions), 3 (Administration), 5 (Membership in System), 7 (Creditable Service), 9, 11, 13 (Retirement and Retirement Benefits) and 15, running from SECTION 9-1-10 to SECTION 9-1-2210. Currency: current through the 2025 Session.
notes: The state's principal defined-benefit plan (SCRS). Related chapters verified in force on the same index but not listed separately because only one statute per topic is recorded: ch. 9-4 (South Carolina Public Employee Benefit Authority, the administering body), ch. 9-11 (Police Officers Retirement System), ch. 9-20 (State Optional Retirement Program) and ch. 9-21 (Retirement Systems Claims Procedures Act). Old-age, survivors and disability insurance is federal (Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. ch. 7); ch. 9-3 and ch. 9-5 only bring South Carolina public officers and employees under federal Social Security.
